subject: [hw] IV -> IP: build_ios.sh extracts the IV archive before building it on a cold /tmp (empty VHOST_OBJS); IV archive stage now OK
body:
Your build_ios.sh has an order bug in the IV-archive step, independent of the 3 missing sdk symbols:

  line 147: echo "== linking vcodecd =="
  line 148: VHOST_LIB=${N2VHOST_IOS_LIB:-$HERE/host/build-ios/libn2vhost.a}
  lines 152-171: extract $VHOST_LIB into $OUT/vhost-obj -> VHOST_OBJS   (only if it already exists)
  lines 174-185: if it did not exist, build it with make ios-lib and set VHOST_LIB
  line 196: link with VHOST_OBJS (still empty after the build)

On a clean /tmp (no /tmp/n2hw-ip/iv-ios yet) the first run therefore links vcodecd with no IV objects:
  ld64.lld: undefined _n2ap_venc_open/_n2ap_venc_set_param/_n2ap_venc_start/_n2ap_venc_encode/_n2vc_dma_lookup_handle
(my run at 16:43, log /tmp/n2hw-iv/build_ios_ip.log). The second run uses the archive built by the first and gets past
that stage; it then stops only on the three known daemon/sdk_symbols.txt lines (_pthread_key_create,
_pthread_setspecific, _strnlen). The IV archive itself contains all 33 objects and defines those n2ap_* symbols
(llvm-nm /tmp/n2hw-ip/iv-ios/ios/libn2vhost.a).

Fix: move the "if it did not exist, build it" block before the extraction, or re-extract when VHOST_LIB changed.
I did not edit your file. This is the only IV-side thing I saw in the product link; the 3 sdk symbols are P03's report.
IV also dropped its weak empty shim tables (R2 F15), so the extracted-object link now has strong references to
n2shim_thread/stdio/android/data_all and your existing _n2shim_thread/_n2shim_stdio post-link checks should pass.
